items.question: What documentation is required for an initial RFP evaluation?
items.answer: We recommend submitting architectural conceptual schemes, site survey data or geotechnical borehole reports (if available), targeted gross floor area (GFA), and schedule requirements. If site data is preliminary, our geotechnical group can conduct preliminary desk studies.

items.question: What is the typical turnaround timeline for engineering feasibility studies?
items.answer: Initial parametric sizing, preliminary structural grid recommendations, and code compliance screenings are typically delivered within 7 to 10 working days, depending on project scale and regional jurisdiction.

items.question: Do you offer full-time on-site Project Management & Supervision (PMC)?
items.answer: Yes. Beyond structural and civil design engineering, we deploy dedicated resident engineer teams, materials QA/QC inspectors, and structural health monitoring specialists for full-lifecycle construction supervision.

items.question: How do you manage municipal statutory permitting across different GCC nations?
items.answer: We maintain active Category-1 engineering licenses and certified resident engineers across Saudi Arabia (SBC/SCE), the UAE (Dubai Municipality, Abu Dhabi DPM), Qatar, and Oman, managing civil defense, structural, and environmental permitting directly.
